subject: BlueRiver: Combined Enablement + Integration Runbook Scheduling
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@blueriverhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Combined enablement + integration runbook

Hi Naomi (and Camila),

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at BlueRiver would like to move to a combined enablement: a console walkthrough for our clinical ops users and an API integration deep-dive for eng. We were hoping to book a single coordinated session so both teams hear the same runbook and we can avoid duplicate alignment.

Ideal week for us is the week of July 13th. Our constraints: clinical ops prefer mornings PT, engineering is only available after 1pm PT on Tue/Thu. Attendee list will be ~6 people (3 clinical users, 3 engineers).

Can Redwood run a 2.5-hour joint session (console 45–60m, API 60–75m, 15m buffer/Q&A)? If a single block is hard we can split into two: console + office hours and a separate API hands-on. Also need the session recorded and a short runbook we can reference afterwards.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Turner
Director, Clinical Integrations
BlueRiver Health

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@blueriverhealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Combined enablement + integration runbook

Thanks Alex — we can absolutely run that. Quick notes and options so we can lock a time: 

- Option A (preferred): Single 2.5-hour joint workshop on Tue July 14, 13:00–15:30 PT (console walkthrough first, then API integration deep-dive).
- Option B: Two shorter sessions — Console walk (1hr morning PT) + API hands-on (1.25hr early afternoon PT) on the same week — helpful if attendees need shorter blocks.

Logistics ask: please confirm the final attendee list and whether the engineers need direct access to a staging API key ahead of time (we can provision read-only tokens). Attachments in this email: a short prep sheet (BlueRiver-prep-sheet.xlsx) and our console quickstart PDF.

Camila will own the calendar logistics; Ben will lead the API segment; Monica will join to cover post-enable success planning and runbook handoff. If you'd like a runbook we typically produce, Ben will attach a lightweight API integration runbook and a sample post-call checklist.

If Option A works, we will send a calendar invite and a Zoom link and request a short pre-call (15m) the day prior to test staging credentials.

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[attachments: BlueRiver-prep-sheet.xlsx; redwood-console-quickstart.pdf]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@blueriverhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-03T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Combined enablement + integration runbook

Adding a technical note — for the API hands-on to be productive we need one of the following ahead of the session:

- Staging API key with limited tokens OR
- A Postman collection + sample payloads we can run against a mocked endpoint (we can host a short-lived mock if you prefer)

I'll attach our API integration runbook (pdf) and a sample Postman collection stub. During the workshop we'll walk through an actual request/response, error handling, and best practices for prefix caching and KV usage that map to your throughput expectations.

Also: we usually record sessions and upload the recording + runbook to a shared Drive folder. If BlueRiver needs an internal-only recording (no external sharing), let us know and we'll toggle settings.

Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

- Alex Turner (Director, Clinical Integrations) – alex.turner@blueriverhealth.com
- Priya Shah (Clinical Ops Lead) – priya.shah@blueriverhealth.com
- Daniel Kim (Nurse Informatics) – daniel.kim@blueriverhealth.com

- Omar Ruiz (Platform Eng) – omar.ruiz@blueriverhealth.com

Staging keys: we have a read-only key ready; I'll DM the key to Naomi + Ben (do not include in calendar). Please send calendar invite + Zoom and the pre-call 15m test slot on Mon July 13, 10:00 PT. We would like the session recorded and the runbook delivered within 48 hours.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Alex
